subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR wait for live Codex app-server proof, or is sibling Codex source-contract inspection plus focused OpenClaw tests enough to continue toward merge?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible and the patch is focused, but OpenClaw policy requires real behavior proof for external PRs unless a maintainer explicitly accepts the source-contract proof gap.

options.title: Require live Codex proof
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording shows read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the live-proof gap and proceed using the sibling Codex contract plus focused OpenClaw tests as sufficient evidence.

options.title: Pause or replace later
options.body: If no live proof appears, maintainers can pause this branch and let a later maintainer-owned or ClawSweeper replacement carry the same narrow fix with proof.

recommendation.title: Require live Codex proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, or a recording shows read-only suppression and mutating warning behavior after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and duplicate-closing comment tie this owner most directly to the Codex/app-server, hooks, and agent warning surfaces involved in the proof decision.
